[[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Valius Ying]] ran a '''gang''' of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and criminals in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the era of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The gang operated out of the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Oroko]]'', and in [[3964 BBY]] joined in the hunt for fugitives [[Zayne Carrick]] and [[Marn Hierogryph]] in the [[Taris system/Legends|Taris system]].
